summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, to announce the timing of its second quarter 2026 financial results release on July 30, 2026, along with a conference call. This is a routine earnings announcement with no M&A, restructuring, or special situation. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. press release for quarterly results. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are discussed. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
